title: Inauguration and Opening Ceremony of the VII JIDFICS
abstract: Ceremony marking the official start of the VII International Conference on Social Sciences and Legal Sciences, with a welcome from the academic authorities of Universidad de Sonora and an overview of the conference program, scientific objectives, and expected contributions to regional research.

title: Keynote: Sociological Perspectives in the Fight Against Gender Violence in Higher Education
abstract: Master conference addressing institutional strategies to prevent and eradicate gender-based violence within university settings, based on a decade of applied research in Mexican higher education institutions and the implementation of gender equality protocols.

title: Symposium: Public Policy and the Prevention of Violence in the Northern Border Region
abstract: Comparative analysis of public safety policies implemented across the northern border corridor. The symposium discusses evidence-based prevention programs, community participation, and the articulation between municipal, state, and federal institutions in violence reduction.

title: Free Papers: Migration, Border Dynamics, and Regional Integration
abstract: Presentation of recent findings on migratory flows through the Sonora-Arizona corridor: social networks of migrants, labor insertion processes, and the impact of migration policies on family dynamics in border communities.

speakers.name: Dra. Nora Emilia Rivera
speakers.institution: Tribunal Superior de Justicia de Sonora

speakers.name: Mtro. Pablo Cota Escalante
speakers.institution: Comisión Estatal de Derechos Humanos de Sonora

authors.name: Mtro. Pablo Cota Escalante
authors.institution: Comisión Estatal de Derechos Humanos de Sonora

abstract: Round table on the challenges of guaranteeing effective access to justice for indigenous peoples in the state of Sonora: linguistic interpretation, customary law recognition, and the institutional reforms required to close the legal gap.

title: Free Papers: Public Health and Psychosocial Care in the Rural Context
abstract: Set of presentations on mental health services availability, chronic disease prevention programs, and community health promotion strategies implemented in rural municipalities of the Caborca region.

title: Keynote: Educational Innovation and Teacher Training for the XXI Century
abstract: Master lecture on disruptive pedagogical models, the integration of digital technologies in the classroom, and competency-based teacher training as levers to transform educational quality in Northern Mexico.

title: Symposium: Regional Development and Value Chains in the Altar Desert
abstract: Analysis of agri-food value chains, cluster competitiveness, and territorial development strategies in the Altar Desert region, with an emphasis on grape production, livestock, and the emerging renewable energy sector.

title: Keynote: Contemporary Perspectives on Gender Studies and Feminist Epistemologies
abstract: Master conference on the evolution of feminist epistemologies and their contribution to the social sciences: from critique of positivist traditions to intersectional methodologies applied in gender studies research.

title: Panel Discussion: Public Security Strategy and Social Cohesion in Sonora

speakers.name: Comandante Rosa Mena Ochoa
speakers.institution: Secretaría de Seguridad Pública de Sonora

authors.name: Comandante Rosa Mena Ochoa
authors.institution: Secretaría de Seguridad Pública de Sonora

abstract: Interdisciplinary dialogue between institutional actors and academia on public security strategy: the role of preventive policing, social cohesion programs, and citizen participation mechanisms in reducing violence indexes.

title: Symposium: Legal Reforms and the Modernization of the Justice System

speakers.name: Dr. Ernesto Saldivar Peña
speakers.institution: Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación

authors.name: Dr. Ernesto Saldivar Peña
authors.institution: Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación

abstract: Symposium on the state of criminal justice reform, oral trials, alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, and the pending agenda in constitutional law regarding human rights standards in Mexico.

title: Free Papers: Educational Trajectories and Rural Schooling
abstract: Research presentations on dropout prevention, multigrade schooling, and the educational trajectories of first-generation university students coming from rural communities in the northwest of the country.

title: Posters Session: Social Research in the Border Region
abstract: Guided tour of the poster exhibition featuring ongoing social research projects: local identity, youth entrepreneurship, water management, and cultural heritage preservation in border municipalities.

title: Free Papers: Migration, Health, and Access to Social Services
abstract: Evidence on the health situation of migrant populations in transit through Sonora: access barriers to public health services, mental health impacts of the migratory process, and recommendations for inclusive health policy.

title: Panel Discussion: Gender Perspective in Research and Public Policy
abstract: Reflection on the mainstreaming of the gender perspective in academic research agendas and public policy design, including gender budgeting, indicator systems, and the evaluation of equality programs at the state level.

title: Closing Ceremony, Awards, and Farewell Message of the VII JIDFICS
abstract: Closing session with recognition of the best free papers and posters presented during the conference, synthesis of conclusions, and the announcement of the next edition of JIDFICS.
